The no-claim cells in this family are written as a BARE em dash without backticks (C7/codex, C8/pi, C8/claude, C12/claude, C12/codex, C23/pi, C23/codex) while the legend spells no-claim as a backticked one - the `from` values are recorded verbatim as they read, so a lane must not 'normalise' them while editing.

C23/pi and C23/codex stay `—` by design (P6.260 records them as 'unknown, not absent'); they are the two cells QC1's own enumeration silently omits, so a lane counting 20 named cells against a headline of 22 should expect exactly this pair.

QC5 emits no ledger edits because both cells are gated on a packaged run at the release sitting; the conditional restamps (C2/claude `—` -> `covered ᵗ`, C12 x3 -> `covered ᵗ`) are written into the plan rows' done_means so a green run is what moves them, never the static read.
